findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 2377aa3fa84396ab1d9cf8d3db2dc667b363f24c, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full base-to-head diff shows this PR replaced `return userTenant === documentTenant;` with `return true;`, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
